name: am-portfolio
description: AM Portfolio Orchestrator for local development and automation

scripts.build: npx -y dotenv-cli -- mvn clean install -DskipTests -s settings.xml
scripts.build:quick: npx -y dotenv-cli -- mvn clean compile -s settings.xml
scripts.run:app: cd portfolio-app && npx -y dotenv-cli -e ../.env -- mvn spring-boot:run
scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "docker,app" -c "magenta,blue" "npm run docker:up" "npm run run:app"
